svg.title: The finance domain model
svg.desc: The main aggregates are Commitment, Voucher, GfmisFile, PaymentBatch, BankChange, Advance, Receipt, Remittance, DailyCash, Fund, SpendingPlan, BankReconciliation, Period and AuditQuery. A voucher refers to a commitment, a contract phase or a non-budget plan line.
